detail.longDescription: After a long wait, Flow 0.7.0 is here! This release focuses on making Flow more dependable when working with calendars, alarms, and remote sources. Highlights: 📱 Device calendar support ⏰ Safer alarms and calendar editing 🔄 Clearer source and sync feedback 📅 Dashboard and calendar improvements 🛠️ Platform updates Read more here: https://www. linwood.dev/flow/0.7.0/ # flutter # opensource # productivity
